blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Maritime Industry Authority (Marina) has suspended the Passenger Ship Safety Certificate (PSSC) of MV OceanJet 788 after the vessel ran aground at the loading dock of Tagbilaran Port in Bohol on Saturday, Oct. 31. The suspension prevents the vessel from operating until it passes a safety inspection and Marina determines that it is seaworthy, the Department of Transportation (DoTr) said on Sunday. Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon ordered Marina to suspend the vessel’s PSSC following Saturday’s incident, which frightened passengers aboard the fastcraft.
